sources.summary: The Royal Institute of British Architects has paid £150,000 to its former president Alan Jones, settling a long-running legal dispute over its handling of his personal information. The £150,000 payment was listed in a draft of the institute's annual financial report, seen by the British magazine Architect's Journal (AJ), which broke the news yesterday.
